beliefs: The box reverses each whitespace-separated word individually, keeping word order [E1, E2]
Whitespace runs (spaces, tabs) collapse to a single space between words [E2]
Leading and trailing whitespace is stripped [E2]
Empty or all-whitespace input maps to empty string [E1, E2]
Case and symbols are preserved within each reversed word [E1]
notes: E2 shows words stay in order but each word's characters are reversed, and whitespace is normalized to single spaces with edges stripped. Replaced whole-string reversal with per-word reversal plus whitespace normalization.
